items.reason: Gap 1 describes overlapping duplicate deliveries both passing the set check before either records the ID, causing concurrent handling.
Gap 0 identifies the unsigned X-Event-Id header as the deduplication key and explains that changing it bypasses deduplication of a signed body.
Gap 2 states that charge.refunded is sent but refund.created is registered, so refund events do not reach the handler.
No gap relies on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
